title: RNA-seq profiling of human hematopoietic cell populations across development.
description: We profiled the transcriptome of human hematopoietic stem and progenitor cell populations from embryonic emergence to adulthood. Overall design: RNAseq of sorted human hematopoietic populations (CD34+CD38-CD90+)
